chapterInfo.content:
42
Asɔrefie ho nsase no nsusuiɛ
1Ɛnna ɔde me firii adi faa atifi fam kwan so kɔɔ ɛho fam abannwa no soɔ, na ɔde me kɔɔ dammoa a ɛda adihɔ ne ɛhɔ dan no ntentensoɔ a ɛhwɛ atifi fam no ho, 2#Hes 41.13 ne ntwemu no, ɛyɛ basafa aduonum, ɛpono ano wɔ atifi fam, na ne trɛ yɛ basafa aduonu nnum; 3#Hes 41.10, 17 ɛda abannwa a ɛwɔ fie no ntentensoɔ, ɛyɛ basafa du; abrannaa hwɛ abrannaa anim, nsamsoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu, 4na adammoa no anim na ɔkwan a ne trɛ yɛ basafa nnum wɔ fie afa mu, ɛkɔ basafa aduonum kwan a ɛwɔ mu no so; na apono no ano hwɛ atifi fam. 5Na soro dammoa no yɛ ntiantia, ɛfiri sɛ mmrannaa no afa fa, na ɛntrɛ sɛ ɛdan no mfimfini no ase deɛ no, 6ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ aborɔsansa, na ɛnni adum sɛ mmannwa no adum no. Ne saa nti na wɔadwom afiri aseɛ deɛ ne mfimfini deɛ no so, firi fam. 7Na aboɔ ban a ɛwɔ adihɔ fam siane dammoa no, ɛho fam abannwa no mu hwɛ dammoa no anim, ne ntwemu basafa aduonu nnum, 8na adammoa a ɛhwɛ ɛho fam abannwa no ntwemu yɛ basafa aduonu nnum, na hwɛ, asɔredan no anim deɛ na ɛyɛ basafa aduonum; 9na adammoa yi pue aboɔ ban no so; ɔkwan a obi firi ɛho fam abannwa no so reba mu a ɔfa soɔ no da apueeɛ fam. 10Abannwa no fasuo trɛ a ɛhwɛ apueeɛ fam no, atuntunatoɔ ne ɛhɔ dan ntentensoɔ mu na adammoa wɔ, 11na ɔkwan da anim. Ɛte sɛ adammoa a ɛwɔ atifi fam no, ne ntwemu ne ne trɛ saa ara ne n’adifire akwan nyinaa ne ne nsiesieeɛ; na sɛdeɛ n’apono ano teɛ no, 12saa ara nso na adammoa a ɛwɔ anafoɔ fam no teteɛ, ɛpono ano wɔ ɔkwan no ti, ɛne ɔkwan a ɛda ɛho aban no anim, ɔkwan a wɔfiri apueeɛ fam nam so ba mu no.
13Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Atifi fam adammoa ne anafoɔ fam adammoa a ɛsisi adihɔ no anim no ne adammoa kronkron a asɔfoɔ a wɔbɛn AWURADE no bɛdi akronkronneɛ mu akronkronneɛ no; ɛhɔ na wɔmfa akronkronneɛ mu akronkronneɛ nguguo, aduane afɔdeɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ no, na ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron. 14Asɔfoɔ no hyɛne mu a, wɔmmfiri kronkronbea hɔ mmfiri adi nnkɔ ɛho fam abannwa no so, na emu hɔ na wɔmfa wɔn ntadeɛ a wɔde som nguo, na ɛyɛ kronkron. Wɔnhyehyɛ ntadeɛ foforɔ ansa na wɔabɛn deɛ ɛyɛ ɔman no deɛ ho.
15Na ɔwiee dan a ɛwɔ mu no susuo no, ɔde me firii adi faa ɛpono kɛseɛ a ani hwɛ apueeɛ fam no kwan so, na ɔsusu hyiaa twan, 16ɔde susuo demmire no susuu apueeɛ fam deɛ no basafa ahanu aduonum, susuo demmire no so de twa hyiae. 17Ɔsusuu atifi fam deɛ no basafa ahanu aduonum, susuo demmire no so, de twa hyiae. 18Ɔsusuu anafoɔ fam deɛ no basafa ahanu aduonum, susuo demmire no so; 19ɔdane kɔɔ atɔeɛ fam kɔsusuu basafa ahanu aduonum, susuo demmire no so. 20Afa nnan no so na ɔsusuu no. Ɔfasuo twa ho hyia twan; ne ntwemu yɛ basafa ahanu aduonum ne ne trɛ yɛ basafa ahanu aduonum, sɛ ɛntwa kronkronbea ne anihumafoɔ deɛ ntam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
